initialise_element_groups: initialise element groups for ASE atoms visualisation with unit cell, bonds, and miller planes
get_rotation_matrix: get a 3x3 rotation matrix from a string like '50x,-10y,120z' for 3D visualisation
get_cell_coordinates: get start and end line coordinates for drawing crystallographic unit cells with optional repeats and dashes
compute_bonds: compute atomic bonds between ASE atoms using neighbor list with configurable radius scaling
get_miller_coordinates: get the intercept points of a miller index plane on a crystallographic unit cell boundary
